prerequisites: To enroll in the Final Degree Project, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from courses prior to the one in which the TFG is located.

At the time of the TFG defense, the student must have passed all remaining subjects of the degree, as established by article 7.7 of the Regulations for the Completion of the Final Degree Project of the University of Vigo.

learning_outcomes.text: Search, organization, and structuring of information on any topic.
Preparation of a report that includes, among other aspects: background, problem or state of the art, objectives, project phases, project development, conclusions, and future lines.
Design of equipment, prototypes, simulation programs, etc., according to specifications.
At the time of requesting the defense of the TFG, the student must justify the acquisition of an adequate level of proficiency in English.

syllabus_topics: Classic engineering projects, which may include design, manufacturing of a prototype, engineering of a production facility, or implementation of a system in any industrial field. These projects generally involve the documentation part of the report (with sections for calculations, specifications, feasibility studies, safety, etc., as required), plans, specifications, and budget, and in some cases, studies related to the execution phase of the project.

Technical, organizational, and economic studies, consisting of studies related to equipment, systems, services, etc., within the fields of the degree, addressing one or more aspects related to design, planning, production, management, operation, and any other relevant engineering field, relating technical alternatives with economic evaluations and discussion and assessment of results when appropriate.

Theoretical-experimental works, of a theoretical, computational, or experimental nature, which constitute a contribution to technology in various engineering fields, including, when appropriate, economic evaluation and discussion and assessment of results.
teaching_methods: Introductory activities (autonomous bibliographic search, reading, processing, and documentation preparation)
Supervised work (individual report preparation according to the regulations)
Presentation (preparation and defense of the work before an evaluation committee according to the regulations)
assessment_rules: The grading of the Final Degree Project report and its defense will be carried out as specified in the Regulations for the Final Degree Project of the School of Industrial Engineering. Students are expected to demonstrate appropriate ethical behavior; detection of unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, or others) will result in an overall grade of fail (0.0) for the academic year. The originality of the report will be subject to study using plagiarism detection software.
